content: macOS menu bar app lifecycle: (1) App Nap throttles timers (frequency reduction), priority, and I/O when app not foreground/visible - menu bar apps are prime candidates since they have no visible window; (2) Apple Energy guide: set timer tolerance >=10%, invalidate repeating timers when no longer needed, avoid polling with timers, use event-driven APIs; (3) MenuBarExtra docs: 'An app that only shows in the menu bar will be automatically terminated if the user removes the extra from the menu bar' - critical lifecycle fact; (4) MenuBarExtra apps should set LSUIElement to hide Dock icon; (5) Timer on main runloop vs background: timers in .default run loop mode don't fire while menu is tracking; (6) @MainActor concurrency: UI state updates must hop to main actor; (7) app may be terminated/reopened frequently - persistence matters.
